subject: math

objective.text: Read and write numbers with digits, number words and expanded form.

source_ref.section: Lesson objective

explanations.title: Expanded form
explanations.text: Expanded form shows the value of each digit in an addition sentence. 1,708 is 1,000 plus 700 plus 8.

source_ref.section: Concept Development, Problem 1

explanations.title: A zero adds nothing
explanations.text: A zero has no term in expanded form. Zero added to a number does not change its value.

source_ref.section: Concept Development, Problem 2

explanations.title: Word form and commas
explanations.text: Say what you read, and write it in words. The comma separates the thousands from the hundreds, tens and ones.

source_ref.section: Concept Development, Problem 2

explanations.title: Word form to standard form
explanations.text: Write each part you hear. Then put the number in the place value chart and in expanded form.

source_ref.section: Concept Development, Problem 3

explanations.title: Expanded form to standard form
explanations.text: Place each term in its place value. Then write the sum as digits.

source_ref.section: Concept Development, Problem 4

examples.title: 1,708 in expanded form
examples.text: 1 thousand, 7 hundreds, 0 tens, 8 ones. So 1,708 is 1,000 plus 700 plus 8.
